notToBeConfusedWith.name: Pancetta
notToBeConfusedWith.note: Cured pork belly rather than jowl: leaner, and it renders less of the soft fat that carries the sauce.

notToBeConfusedWith.name: Bacon
notToBeConfusedWith.note: Usually smoked, which guanciale is not, and the smoke dominates a dish built on cured pork and cheese.

generalSubstitutes.note: The usual stand-in where guanciale is unavailable. Expect a leaner result and less rendered fat to bind the sauce.

forms.label: Cured
forms.sourceNote: USDA has no record for guanciale. This is its record for raw cured salt pork, the closest cured-pork-fat profile it publishes; treat the figures as indicative of the cut rather than specific to it.
